english.notes: As of 01/10/2024 this offence is no longer in use. Regulation 7 was repealed by reg 2(5) of SI 2024/165.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the level 5 on the standard scale

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
Complex - three years from the commission of the offence or one year from its discovery by the prosecutor, whichever is the earlier

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
